title: Pressure Vessels
summary: Custom industrial pressure vessels, process drums, receivers and storage vessels manufactured to project-specific design conditions, materials and applicable codes.
body:
Tongyang manufactures custom industrial pressure vessels for chemical, petrochemical, oil and gas, energy and utility applications. Each project is reviewed against the specified operating conditions, design pressure and temperature, process medium, materials, fabrication drawings and documentation requirements.

Types of pressure vessels

  • Process drums and separators: vessels for defined process and phase-handling duties

  • Air receivers and accumulators: pressure-containing equipment for utility and buffer services

  • Adsorber vessels: shells designed around specified internals and operating conditions

  • Storage and surge vessels: equipment for specified gas or liquid storage and process buffering

  • Custom fabricated vessels: configurations with project-specific nozzles, supports, manways and internals

Industries and applications

  • Chemical and petrochemical plants

  • Oil and gas processing facilities

  • Fertilizer and industrial gas systems

  • Energy plants and industrial utilities

  • Process storage, separation, filtration and surge services

Key technical parameters for quotation

  • Capacity and configuration: working/total volume, vertical or horizontal orientation, dimensions and layout

  • Design conditions: operating and design pressure, operating and design temperature, vacuum conditions where applicable, and fluid properties/group

  • Construction materials: shell/head materials, corrosion allowance, lining or cladding, insulation and coating

  • Mechanical interfaces: nozzle schedule, internals, supports, lifting provisions and transport restrictions

  • Quality requirements: NDE extent, pressure testing, third-party inspection, material traceability and final documentation

Manufacturing and applicable design codes

Welding procedures, material traceability, inspection plans and fabrication documentation are defined by the approved project specification. Depending on the project and equipment category, the design basis may include ASME Section VIII, GB/T 150 or EN 13445, where applicable. PED conformity assessment or EAC/TR CU requirements must be evaluated separately against the equipment, destination market and contractual scope.

Applicable code editions, certification markings, inspection and testing requirements are confirmed for each order. A product category page does not imply a universal pressure rating or automatic compliance with every listed code or certification scheme.

ASME U and U2 Stamp Capability

Tongyang holds ASME authorization for the U and U2 Certificates of Authorization. The ASME U Stamp applies to pressure vessels manufactured to ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code, Section VIII, Division 1; the ASME U2 Stamp applies to vessels manufactured to Section VIII, Division 2. The applicable Division, design requirements, certification scope and marking are confirmed for each project.

Fabrication resources

Pressure-vessel fabrication is supported by heavy plate processing, CNC cutting and large-component handling resources. Available shop equipment includes plate rolling capacity up to 120 mm, CNC cutting capacity up to 80 mm and lifting capacity up to 200 tonnes. The applicable limits for an individual vessel depend on material grade, component geometry, fabrication sequence and shop handling review.

Preparing a pressure vessel RFQ

For an initial review, provide the equipment data sheet or general arrangement drawing, design conditions, process medium, material requirements and applicable code. If available, include the nozzle schedule, internals, inspection requirements and destination market.

Use our Pressure Vessel RFQ Checklist to help organize the technical information needed for a quotation.

Quotation basis: final design, fabrication scope, certification, testing, documentation and delivery schedule are subject to review and confirmation of the project specification.
